_about: The Anomalous Force Protein (weight_booster, 339) also throws grenades 15 % farther while in a pocket (the owner, 2026-11-05): a built-in modification 1290 of player modifier 27 (grenade_throw_power, the Grenadier skill's: throw speed x max(0, 1 + S27), 0x30A2DE), +0.15 as the booster's +5 kg (1124), docs/notes/force-protein.md.
